title: Warm Egyptian Flour Flatbread
description: A tangy and juicy Egyptian dish featuring flour, perfect for a quick fix, made in a cataplana vessel, this flatbread is a delicious and satisfying meal option, it is also nut free friendly
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled cataplana vessel, cover it with a lid, and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Bake the flatbread for 15 minutes, or until it is golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and brush it with olive oil and lemon juice.
Let the flatbread cool for a few minutes before serving.
